newsitem.title: JAPAN: M'shita develops interactive broadcast technology.
newsitem.headline: M'shita develops interactive broadcast technology.

text.p: Matsushita Electric Industrial Co Ltd said on Tuesday it had developed still-image carousel broadcasting technology which will enable on-demand information services in satellite digital broadcasting.
The technology will be incorporated into software for set-top boxes for DirecTV's satellite digital broadcasting service.

DirecTV Japan, which is a partnership between Hughes Electronics Corp's DirecTV International Inc, Matsushita and other Japanese companies, is expected to begin broadcasting in November or December this year and to offer 72 to 96 channels.
